paper_title: NExtLong Toward Effective Long-Context Training without Long Documents
caption: NExtLong reduces the model's dependence on proximal text. We calculated the degree of dependence on proximal text (the last third of the text) for different methods when completing the LongQA task. It can be observed that NExtLong significantly reduces the model's dependence on proximal text.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Short-Dependence Attention Weight for several methods. The horizontal axis, labeled “Methods”, lists the categories “Standard”, “ICLM”, “KNN”, “Quest”, and “NExTLong” in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Attention Weight”, is a linear scale ranging from 0.80 to 0.90 with tick labels incrementing by 0.02. Each method is represented by a single, light blue bar. The “Standard” bar extends to approximately 0.865, while the “ICLM” bar reaches a value of around 0.855. The “KNN” and “Quest” bars are both approximately 0.86 in height, and the “NExTLong” bar is the shortest, extending to roughly 0.825. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
